title: Rework the Surzion storefront's SMART PAGES (the published website "shop") so it
description: Rework the Surzion storefront's SMART PAGES (the published website "shop") so it
originating_prompt:
Rework the Surzion storefront's SMART PAGES (the published website "shop") so it matches the reference site https://surzion.com/ and behaves like a standard e-commerce store. Delegate to the smart-page-designer and run the smart-page-reviewer; read the smart-page skill for the exact block shapes (several blocks are new: in-cart stepper + toast on add_to_cart, wishlist_button / wishlist_badge / wishlist_lines, cardStyle + fill on card, cart_checkout, my_records, reviews, embed signInPrompt, auth_menu / auth_form incl. identify-first mode with email OR mobile). Do not ask clarifying questions — make sensible choices and list them at the end. The data model was updated in the previous turn (surz_order row-secured by REGISTRY_ID, surz_customer_address, surz_customer_payment_method, surz_product_review with STATUS PENDING/APPROVED/REJECTED, partner role).

1. Theme & readability: use Poppins (headings) + Libre Baskerville or a clean serif/sans pairing like the reference, base font size 17-18px, a calmer heading scale (scaleRatio ~1.25), enough line height. Body text, card titles and prices must read comfortably.

2. Home hero — reproduce the reference exactly: the large SURZION "THE SURGICAL EXCELLENCE" logo image, then the "BY" + KAPSONS logo image (the "by Kapsons" brand line), the subtitle "Quality Surgical Instruments Supplier in India", and two buttons "Shop Now" and "Explore Products" (both to the shop/catalogue). Reference images: https://assets.zyrosite.com/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,w=2800,h=1029,fit=crop/dJoPq545ePc4y7po/untitled-design-1-2fOKm0tY1M4A7Tcy.png (Surzion logo) and https://assets.zyrosite.com/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,w=1440,h=317,fit=crop/dJoPq545ePc4y7po/untitled-design-3-wPHYU0kKxks4USI9.png (BY KAPSONS) — import them into the page asset library if they are not there already (check Page_Design/assets/index.json first). Give the hero section a subtle image background with PARALLAX enabled and an entrance/scroll-reveal animation on the logo and buttons, as the reference has.

3. Category cards ("Product Categories"): clear separation from the page background — white cards with a visible border and shadow on a lightly tinted section, equal height, consistent image framing, "Explore Collection" CTA per card linking to that category.

4. Product cards everywhere (home featured, shop, online catalogue, category pages): equal size (card fill in the repeat grid, square image frame), price at the bottom, add_to_cart with the in-cart stepper (shows "In cart · N" with −/+ once added) and the toast linking to the cart page, and a wishlist heart. The add_to_cart sku MUST be the product's PRODUCT_CODE (the order line key) — fix any card using a slug or _txn_id.

5. Testimonials: add a testimonials section (carousel, 5-star rating) to the home page and the shop page, starting with the reference's testimonial: Dr. Sharma, 5 stars — "Surzion provides top-notch surgical instruments. Their quality and service are unmatched, making them my go-to supplier for medical needs." Add two or three more realistic ones from hospital/clinic buyers marked clearly as sample content.

6. Header: add an auth_menu (Sign in / Create account when signed out; when signed in: My account, My orders, Wishlist, Partner account, change password, Sign out), a wishlist_badge next to the cart badge. Add a branded login page (auth_form, register link, forgot password) and set it as application.auth.loginPage.

7. Footer: proper spacing — generous top/bottom padding, spacing between the columns, divider and the bottom copyright row; keep the reference footer content (tagline, Contact us, phone numbers, Follow us, policy links, enquiry form).

8. Checkout: replace the raw order entry form with the cart_checkout block (requireSignIn: true — every order belongs to an account) (contact + delivery address with the saved-address picker from surz_customer_address and "save this address", read-only order summary) wired via orderIdVar to the payment_checkout block (Pay online / Cash on Delivery — COD is on by default). Browsing, cart and wishlist need NO sign-in. At checkout the shopper enters their email or mobile number: an unknown one creates their account automatically and continues (a set-password link is sent); a known one asks them to log in or use forgot password (the block's identify step does this). Order confirmation shows the order number and server total.

9. New pages (add to the site navigation/menus): "My orders" (my_records block, heading "My orders", over surz_order with lines, status chips, reorder), "Wishlist" (wishlist_lines), "My account" (address book + saved payment methods via embeds of surz_customer_address / surz_customer_payment_method in list+edit mode, with signInPrompt wording).

10. Product pages: add a reviews block (object surz_product_review, record = the page's PRODUCT_CODE, approved value APPROVED, pending PENDING, signed-in submit, one per account, purchaseCheck against the shopper's own surz_order lines (form 2, PRODUCT_CODE) so only buyers can review, with the Verified purchase badge) under the product details. Anyone can read approved reviews without signing in.

11. Partner portal: its embeds are per-account — give them a signInPrompt ("Sign in to your partner account") and gate the portal content to the partner role where appropriate; the Partners page explains how to apply (signed-in customers apply; approval grants the partner role).

Verify every page (page_verify / reviewer) and summarise every change per page.
result_summary:
odel_surz_home.json`)**
- **Hero:** I imported the BY KAPSONS image into the asset library and put it in place of the two text blocks the designer had used. The hero has the parallax background and entrance animations on the logo, BY KAPSONS and the buttons. I kept the existing Surzion logo asset because it already contains "THE SURGICAL EXCELLENCE", and I did not import that second reference image.
- **Content:** Category cards are white with a border and shadow, equal height, with an "Explore Collection" button. The featured products and a testimonial carousel are below them.

**Theme and header**
- **Theme:** Poppins for headings and Libre Baskerville for body text. Base size is 17, scale ratio 1.25, line height 1.7.
- **Header:** It now has the sign-in menu and a wishlist badge next to the cart.

**Footer and cart**
- **Footer:** Rebuilt with generous spacing, a divider and a copyright row, keeping the reference content.
- **Cart:** Only the styling changed.

**Shop, catalogue and category pages**
- **Product cards:** They are equal-size with a square image, the price at the bottom, a wishlist heart, add-to-cart with the "In cart · N" stepper, and a toast linking to the cart. The sku is PRODUCT_CODE.
- **Testimonials:** Dr. Sharma's five-star quote comes first, then three sample ones labelled as sample, on home and shop.
- **Category pages:** New pages for Orthopaedic, General and Dissecting.

**Checkout**
- **Flow:** The raw order form is replaced by the cart checkout block, sign-in required, with the saved-address picker and "save this address". It feeds the payment block.
- **Payment:** Pay online or Cash on Delivery. The page can't make COD the default; the order's payment action and the project's Payments setup decide that.

**New pages**
- **Login page:** Sign-in by email or mobile, set as `application.auth.loginPage`.
- **My orders, Wishlist and My account:** All three are in the navigation. My account has the address book and payment methods.

**Partner pages**
- **Embeds:** They show "Sign in to your partner account".
- **Orders section:** The "Orders placed with my code" section is visible only to the partner role.
- **Application section:** It stays open to signed-in customers, so applicants can see their status.
- **Apply page:** It explains the apply and approval steps.

**Product pages (22 `model_surz_p_*.json`)**
- **SKUs:** Every sku, including the related-product cards, is now the real PRODUCT_CODE.
- **Cart and wishlist:** Each page has the in-cart stepper, the toast and a wishlist heart.
- **Reviews:** A reviews block sits under the details.

**Files touched:** the page models, `Page_Design/assets/` (index plus the new image) and the `auth.loginPage` key in `application.json`. Navigation entries were added for the new pages. The project has no `requirement_doc.md`, so there was no FRS to update.

**Choices to check**
- **Product names:** Three products have names that don't match their page slugs. `bulldog-clamps` is SURZ-0017 but named "Babcock Forceps TC", `bulldog-clamps1` is SURZ-0021 named "Artery Forceps Dandy", and `dandy-artery-forceps-55` is SURZ-0019 named "Bone Hook". The designer matched by slug, so please check the product master.
- **"TC" category:** There is no TC category in the data, so that card links to the full shop.
- **Verified purchase badge:** It will not show, because `surz_product_review` has no column for the verified flag. A `VERIFIED` column on that table would switch it on.
- **Purchase check:** It accepts any order status. Tell me which statuses count as bought, for example DELIVERED only, and I'll add them.
- **Mobile sign-in:** `application.auth.defaultCountryCode` is not set, so shoppers must type mobile numbers with the country code, for example +91.
- **Link kind:** Calls to action on these site pages use fixed paths such as `/cart`, because in-app navigation doesn't work on external pages.
- **Page count:** There are 22 product pages, not about 24. All were converted.
